description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.
